name: io.github.douglasdemaio/vtessera
description: Find vtessera agent offers, read agent cards, route an intent, and read signed attestations.

packageArguments.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read

environmentVariables.name: VTESSERA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.

vtessera/draft.why: Two fields need an artefact this repository does not have yet: a published container image, and a hosted MCP endpoint. Both are deployment decisions, so both belong to the operator.
blockers: packages[0].identifier is an OCI reference. The registry has no binary package type for a Go program, so the listing names a container image. Publishing one is `make image` plus a push, which is a deploy decision.
remotes[0].url needs a hosted vtessera-mcp. The server already serves streamable HTTP with --listen, but nothing is deployed in front of it.
packages[0].identifier and version must name an image that exists before submission, or the listing advertises a package nobody can pull.
Submitting also needs a GitHub OAuth token with repo scope, which is the publisher's to hold.
beforeSubmitting: Replace every TODO in this file. A test fails if one remains while readyToSubmit is true.
Set version here to the same string as mcpserver.Version, which is what a client sees at initialize. A listing and a binary that disagree is worse than either alone.
Publish the image, then set fileSha256 if the digest is known.
vtessera/draft.schemaCheckedIn: server.schema.json is the published 2025-09-29 schema, fetched and stored so this file is validated without a network call.
